Message.Name: Order Imbalance Message
Message.Description: The Order Imbalance message provides order imbalance information at the Indicative Equilibrium Price (IEP) during the Pre-Opening Session (POS) and Closing Auction Session (CAS).

Field.Name: SecurityCode
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies a security available for trading.

Field.Name: OrderImbalanceDirection
Field.Description: Indicates the imbalance direction when the matchable buy quantity and sell quantity at IEP are not equal.

Field.Name: OrderImbalanceQuantity
Field.Description: The absolute difference between the matchable buy quantity and sell quantity at IEP. Value should be ignored if Order Imbalance Direction is space.
